definitions.BCC-1: All eleven realization units physically exist and are CERTIFIED.
definitions.BCC-2: Meta-class realization complete — DMC-01…10 realized; no eleventh meta-class.
definitions.BCC-3: Meta-model integration complete — the DATA-005 model-of-the-model is CERTIFIED.
definitions.BCC-4: Dependency closure acyclic, downward-only; no forward/upward dependency.
definitions.BCC-5: Consistency — the whole-band spine closes over DMR-01…12 (via U11).
definitions.BCC-6: Reuse by reference — no EL-1/prior-unit concept redefined; no new primitive.
definitions.BCC-7: Non-constitutive — the completion confers no authority and selects no technology.
definitions.BCC-8: Non-projection — realization completion is not operational/deployment readiness.
